name: 2: 14-day QP not reached; remove earnings
description: Creates an apprenticeship with a 99-day planned duration (14–167 day band, qualifying period = 14 days), approves it, then records a pause after 9 days in learning. Because 9 < 14, earnings for periods prior to the pause date should be removed. Covers FLP-1424 AC2.

steps.name: SLD Records Pause (9 days in learning — below 14-day qualifying period)
